notes: Silicon Labs' own careers page sends Browse Job Openings to silabs.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/SiliconLabsCareers. Membership is POST /wday/cxs/silabs/SiliconLabsCareers/jobs with {appliedFacets, limit, offset, searchText, sortBy}. The live facet list is jobFamilyGroup, workerSubType, timeType, locationMainGroup (nested locationCountry + locations) and distance; there is no jobFamily facet and no workplaceType facet. workerSubType (Regular / Intern (Fixed Term) (Seasonal) (Trainee)) is a real facet but is not one of the canonical keys. 82 postings at verification time.
